Trump in a social media post announced the agreement he said was negotiated by Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth and Venezuela’s interim President Delcy Rodriguez. “The United States of America has just entered into an Agreement with the Country of Venezuela on, THE BIGGEST OIL DEAL IN WORLD HISTORY!”... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Doctor behind world's first voluntary assisted death welcomes new NT law
item.description: Dr Philip Nitschke, who helped a terminal cancer patient through the world's first legal voluntary assisted dying process 30 years ago, welcomes the NT's new laws, but concerns remain about how prognosis will be factored in. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jane Bardon

item.title: Tasmania's premier and deputy potentially at odds over conversion ban
item.description: Tasmania's Deputy Premier Guy Barnett has written to an anti-trans feminist group labelling the Greens' bill to ban conversion practices as "fundamentally flawed". His views potentially put him at odds with Premier Jeremy Rockliff. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Josh Duggan

item.title: Pigeon race still on in Victoria's west despite bird flu outbreak
item.description: A wildlife advocacy group fears a pigeon racing fundraiser could spread H5 bird flu from coastal to inland Victoria. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Violette Storm

item.title: Magpies legend Pendlebury set to join Gold Coast Suns for 2027 season
item.description: AFL games record holder Scott Pendlebury will join the Gold Coast Suns in 2027 as an unrestricted free agent. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: British far-right activist Milo Yiannopoulos arrested by ICE
item.description: US immigration officials arrested controversial British far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos on Thursday in New Orleans, according to the Department of Homeland Security. Immigration officials announced on Friday that Yiannopoulos was arrested at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport and accused him of overstaying after entering the United States legally in May 2019 through New York. An immigration judge issued a final order of removal on July 22 after Yiannopoulos failed to show... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Once-in-a-lifetime' mourning ceremony for Bendigo's Russell Jack
item.description: The traditional Cantonese mourning lion ceremony has not been seen in the region in living memory. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Anna McGuinness

item.title: Unlikely team uncover source of mysterious space lights seen in Queensland
item.description: Hobby astronomers partner with a retired NASA engineer to investigate the source of swirling lights seen in the night sky from Central Queensland. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Bryn Wakefield

item.title: Planned statue of ex-Victorian premier Daniel Andrews scrapped
item.description: Victorian premier Ben Carroll has cancelled plans to immortalise his predecessor Dan Andrews in statue form outside Melbourne's Treasury Place. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Alex Sinnott

item.title: Why China's censors are scrubbing videos of the Nepal-Tibet floods
item.description: After a horrifying video of a landslide hitting China-controlled Tibet emerged online, it started to disappear in China. This is just one way Beijing is trying to control information about the disaster. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Allyson Horn

item.title: Number of Australians missing in Nepal’s deadly floods rises again, as Albanese deploys more personnel
item.description: There are now 41 Australians missing, and four rapid response team members are expected to arrive in Kathmandu At least 93,000 ‘in great need’ after Nepal-Tibet flash floods How the deadly Nepal and Tibet flash flood unfolded – a visual guide Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The number of Australians who were reported missing in the catastrophic Nepal flooding disaster has risen to 41, as one family celebrates after an unaccounted-for woman made contact with them yesterday. It means three additional Australians were confirmed missing overnight – up from 38 who… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Stephanie Convery and Cait Kelly in Kathmandu

item.title: Street artists turn rusting opal machinery into outback spectacle
item.description: A renowned Australian artist offers city street artists a blank canvas to turn discarded opal-mining equipment into an outback open-air gallery. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Catherine James

item.title: Push to declare garden favourite sold at Bunnings a weed
item.description: The Invasive Species Council wants the common sweet pea plant, Polygala myrtifolia, with its pretty purple flowers recognised as a significant weed and removed from sale. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Gavin McGrath

item.title: One Nation takes on 'safe' Labor seat in closely watched WA by-election
item.description: Can One Nation break into a Labor heartland? Vote counting is underway in Western Australia as the polls close in the Secret Harbour by-election. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Keane Bourke and Lucy Murray

item.title: What makes a 'real' daffodil? Prospective judges learn the ropes
item.description: Judging daffodils at flower shows isn't something Robert and Kerrie Goudsouzian ever thought they'd do. But, as judge numbers dwindle, they are learning the finer points of judging and say it's "just lovely". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Loretta Lohberger

item.title: Council plans $15-25m bus stop upgrade amid anti-social behaviour concerns
item.description: Business owners say antisocial behaviour at a city bus stop "is getting out of hand", but they are not sure a new council plan to spend $15-25 million revamping the area will fix the issue. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emily Smith

item.title: Former ASIO agent offers to give evidence to Bondi royal commission
item.description: The former agent, known as Marcus, worked with ASIO to infiltrate Islamic State networks in Western Sydney years before the attack. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tom Lowrey

item.title: Melbourne council ditches e-bike and e-scooter trial amid complaints
item.description: Another Melbourne council ends its "micromobility" trial of shared e-bikes and e-scooters after 93 per cent of feedback was negative. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Margaret Paul

item.title: Sacked ALDI worker's use of AI as 'quasi-legal advisor' condemned
item.description: The Fair Work Commission will soon require applicants to disclose any AI use with consequences for failing to be transparent. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jade Toomey

item.title: The murky lagoon harbouring a centuries-old maritime mystery
item.description: The elusive Deadwater wreck is Western Australia's longest-running maritime mystery, encompassing colonial eyewitness accounts, artefacts tenuously linked to the wreck, and vivid folklore involving treasure, matricide and piracy. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jon Daly

item.title: Historian solves mystery of concrete pillars unearthed at Sydney beach
item.description: The concrete cylinders were a regular sight at the eastern suburbs beach after tidal events, but were taken away four years after becoming a hazard to beachgoers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Declan Bowring

item.title: Australia's oldest surviving colonial homestead to unlock its doors today
item.description: Some of Western Sydney's most interesting and historic sites, including Australia's oldest surviving public building, will be unlocked to the public for one day. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Gavin Coote

item.title: Wetland thriving with aquatic life again a glimpse of carp-free future
item.description: While conservationists and fishers have formed an action group calling for more management of the pest fish now, Teal Flat provides a glimpse of what could be possible, even without a carp herpes virus. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Eliza Berlage

item.title: Labor's MotoGP coup crashes into an all-too-familiar parklands wall
item.description: One day, Peter Malinauskas might bask in the glory of bringing another popular major event to Adelaide. For now, his MotoGP coup is being fiercely resisted. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Kelsall

item.title: Australian talent is the biggest loser in Super Netball signings
item.description: Several Australians miss out on playing contracts in the world's best league as New Zealand's competition collapses. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Brittany Carter

item.title: La llamada de Cara, la australiana dada por desaparecida que escapa a pie del caos entre Tíbet y Nepal
item.description: Entre el lodo y los miles de desaparecidos por las riadas en el Himalaya, los rescatistas hallan a los primeros supervivientes mientras la crisis humanitaria se agrava y las morgues colapsan Leer Fuente: El Mundo - Internacional.
item.dc:creator: Gonzalo Aguirregomezcorta

item.title: How England are building an attack to trouble Australia
item.description: Former England captain Michael Vaughan predicts England's new pace quartet will trouble Australia - so what is making them effective against Pakistan? Fuente: BBC Sport.
